system.description:
While an ally you can see has 12 or more wounds, you gain +1 Talent Point in Grit and in Wit until they are healed. If you are within 10 ft of that ally, they are also Steeled.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.76
system.summary: While an ally you can see has 12 or more wounds, you gain +1 Talent Point in Grit and in Wit until they are healed. If you are within 10 ft of that ally, they are also Steeled.

when.label: An ally you can see has 12 or more wounds

automation.note: The +1 Talent Point in Grit and Wit is the +1 Talent Die box on those checks. Target the badly wounded ally while within 10 ft and Use this to mark them Steeled; remove it once they are healed or you are more than 10 ft away.
